verification: Criteria text below was read from the public Devpost pages on 2026-11-08. This file is not a live rules check.
weights: The event page described five criteria. This file does not assign numeric weights as a score.

criteria.name: Potential Impact
criteria.quote: Does the project make a credible case for solving a real problem for a real audience? Does the solution address that problem based on what's demonstrated?

criteria.name: Technological Implementation
criteria.quote: How thoroughly and skillfully does the project use Kiro? Was there a thoughtful strategy to AI development?

criteria.name: Design
criteria.quote: Does the project deliver a complete, coherent product experience, not just a technical proof of concept?

criteria.name: Innovation/Idea
criteria.quote: How creative and novel is the concept, and does the project differ from existing concepts?

criteria.name: Presentation
criteria.quote: Does the video clearly demonstrate the project working end-to-end?
